# Folding the Hull

*Test fixture. This text is invented for automated tests and comes from no published book.*

A paper boat begins as a rectangle and ends as a promise that it will float.

## Start with a dry sheet

Choose a sheet with no creases. A damp sheet folds into a soft hull, and a soft hull takes on water before it leaves the bank.

## Make three folds and stop

Fold the sheet in half, fold the corners to the center, and fold the brim up on both sides. A fourth fold adds weight and no strength.
